caption: The drawing depicts a wooden cabinet with two main sections: an upper hutch and a lower table. The upper hutch features a set of four vertical glass-panel doors, each door having an arched windowpane design. The glass panels appear to have light reflections illustrated with white highlights. Behind the glass, shelves are visible. The topmost part of the cabinet has a wide overhanging cornice. The lower section consists of a table with four legs that are straight with slight tapering and bevels, ending in rounded feet. The table has three drawers in the upper row and one long drawer underneath, all with round wooden knobs. The color of the wood throughout the cabinet is a range of medium to dark brown tones, while the tabletop surface appears lighter in color, suggesting a different type of wood or finish. The background is a simple light beige or cream wash, and the artist's signature, "Eugene Croc," is visible in the lower right corner.
title: Secretary Desk
